name: issue-board
description: Report, triage, fix and verify issues on an issue board through its MCP server.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: The MCP endpoint you were given, e.g. https://board.example.com/mcp

token.title: Personal token
token.description: Your personal token from the board's token page (starts with qat_). Stored in your OS keychain.
